panels.description: Alex and Ada enter the sealed old workings through the unwired door; folded Bi11bot rests in Alex's bag. Condensation beads on the inner surface. Leave upper tunnel space.
The mine branches. Alpha's projection shows a straight route while Ada's paper map marks a leftward pipe. Leave upper tunnel space.
Alex presses his palm to the wall; a faint vibration answers. Leave upper rock space.
Fresh bolts and condensation lead left. Leave upper wall space.
